name: myocr
description: Convert PDF bank statements into Excel and check that the balances add up to the cent. Also invoices, tables and scanned documents.

capabilities: Check that statement balances add up
Convert invoices and tables to Excel
defaultPrompt: Convert the bank statement I uploaded to Excel and tell me if the balances add up
Check whether any transaction is missing from this bank statement
Extract the table in this PDF to Excel

positive.description: Bank statement to Excel with balance check
positive.prompt: Convert the bank statement I uploaded to Excel and tell me if the balances add up
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the conversion with document_type bank_statement, polls the status until done, then gives the download link of the .xlsx file and the balance check: consistent, opening 12,450.00, credits 6,039.62, debits 5,355.95, closing 13,133.67.

positive.prompt: Check whether any transaction is missing from this bank statement
positive.expected_behavior: Converts the statement and reports the balance check as inconsistent with a difference of 49.00, meaning a transaction is missing or was misread.

positive.description: Table from a PDF to Excel
positive.prompt: Extract the table in this PDF to Excel
positive.expected_behavior: Converts with document_type tables and gives the download link of the .xlsx file with the price list table.

positive.prompt: How many pages do I have left on myocr.app?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the pages available on the connected account and the limits per document (pages and file size), without any email address.
Reports that the report is on record for Demo Bank plc, period 01/08/2026 - 31/08/2026, account ending 4821, with result consistent, and gives the public verification link.

negative.prompt: Convert this Word file to Excel (a .docx file is attached)
Show me the conversions of another myocr.app user

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything in ChatGPT, shows no plans or prices and links to no pricing or purchase page. It only uses the pages already available in the user's existing myocr.app account; when they are not enough, the tool says so and stops without charging anything.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Changed after review: when the account does not have enough pages, the tool says so without linking to any pricing or plans page.
